title: Retain the last measurable transcript anchor across spacer-only frames
outcome: captureLatestVisibleMessageAnchor now writes null over a valid anchor when the DOM is transiently spacer-only. Page-height reconciliation then loses anchorOffsetDelta and can apply a zero layoutHeightDelta for the first visible page, leaving detached readers uncompensated when an at-or-above page changes height. Separate an explicit authoritative anchor clear at the navigation seam from a momentarily unmeasurable capture, retain the last good anchor during transient gaps, and add a positive correction regression after a pane-owned upward write.
acceptance: Transiently unmeasurable slots do not erase a valid anchor; explicit navigation can clear it intentionally; measurable post-write page changes still produce the expected detached-anchor correction without replaying a stale pre-write position.
